quotes.text: repeated ArrowDown should fire select only on first press and keyup

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Newer accepted TreeListboxMixin updates selection highlights and scrolling for every repeated navigation key but defers select callbacks until keyup or blur. Its test expects2events for repeated ArrowDown: first press and release, with final index4. A single press remains immediate. Preserve blur cleanup so deferred downstream folder loading is not lost when focus changes. Tests were read, not run; this later accepted behavior must not be attributed to the2024 reland.
title: Coalesce expensive tree selection processing during key repeats
